title: AI Visual Inspection
alt: AI vision cameras and robotic arms inspecting circuit boards on a production line, with a live inspection dashboard
desc: Edge-deployed computer vision trained on line-specific defect libraries (surface, dimensional, print and assembly-completeness), with sub-second inference and a human-in-the-loop review queue.
outcomes: Reduced escaped-defect rate and less end-of-line manual sampling
Audit-ready defect trail suitable for GMP and OEM reviews

title: Packaging & Bin-Count Verification
alt: Live packing dashboard showing units packed this hour against the hourly target with a behind-pace alert
desc: Vision-based AI counts each piece as it is placed and checks the final count against target before a container is sealed, with an auditable photo record and a logged override for exceptions.
outcomes: Miscounts caught at the packing station in seconds, not at the customer dock
Photo-backed proof of what shipped, with no added paperwork

title: Predictive Maintenance
alt: Maintenance engineer reviewing a predictive-maintenance dashboard on a tablet beside a CNC machine on the plant floor
desc: Vibration, temperature, current and pressure data streamed to on-premise ML models trained on asset-specific failure signatures, with remaining-useful-life alerts and CMMS/EAM work-order integration.
outcomes: Fewer unplanned stoppages on critical lines and utilities
Shift from calendar-based to condition-based maintenance

title: Production Planning
alt: Laptop showing an AI production-planning co-pilot generating a monthly production report
desc: Agentic re-planning that proposes revised schedules when an order changes. A plain-language interface lets planners request a build plan or dispatch report, checked against the BOM and live stock before anything is committed.
outcomes: Improved on-time delivery against customer commitments
Minutes, not hours, to turn a request into an approval-ready order

title: Real-Time Shop-Floor Monitoring
alt: Wide view of a busy manufacturing shop floor with robotic welding cells, CNC machines and operators
desc: Real-time OEE, throughput and quality dashboards built on your existing SCADA/MES data and deployed on-premise, with an AI copilot that flags anomalies as they emerge and Andon-style escalation.
outcomes: Slowdowns caught within the hour, not at shift-end
Single real-time view of OEE across lines and shifts

title: Brazing Furnace Optimization
alt: Brazing furnace thermal-profile dashboard showing setpoint versus actual zone temperatures with an AI zone adjustment
desc: ML models trained on furnace zone temperatures, belt speed and atmosphere against downstream leak-test results, recommending parameter adjustments to hold the optimal thermal profile as load and product mix vary.
outcomes: Reduced scrap and rework from weak or over-brazed joints
Lower energy per unit through tighter thermal-profile control

title: Heat-Exchanger Circuit Router
alt: Refrigerant circuit routing layout generated by the Incolo Circuit Router: circuits drawn as horizontal bands of front and rear bends
desc: Generates refrigerant circuit (CKT) routing layouts for fin-and-tube heat exchangers from the coil grid, target circuits, parity, flow direction and dummy holes. It applies the design team's bend, drainage and coverage rules, balances circuit sizes across the face, and exports an SVG/PDF reference with every run saved for audit and reuse.
outcomes: Circuit layouts generated in one step instead of drawn by hand
Design rules enforced on every layout, with deviations explained
Every run stored with inputs and output for traceability
meta: Runs fully offline on your PC or plant server

inputs: The front-face grid of the coil
Target circuits & minimum holes per circuit
How many circuits, and the smallest allowed
Even, odd or any: even circuits exit on the front face, odd on the rear
Incline (upward flow, evaporator and water coils) or decline (downward flow, condensers)
Holes excluded from every circuit, marked by clicking the grid
detail.rulesTitle: Design rules enforced on every run
rules: Every bend joins a true neighbour on the staggered lattice: no long skip bends, and no bends cross
Circuits stack as compact horizontal bands that only step in the flow direction, so there are no traps
A wrong-way move is at most a single half-pitch dip, never in the final two steps
Circuit sizes are interleaved across the face, not clustered
If the exact target can't be met, the count is reduced and the deviation is explained
Isolated holes are offered as suggested dummies, applied in one click
